card.title: Build up journal actions and compare one addition at a time
card.body: Reservoir Scope 0.11.0 adds a separate Actions & comparisons workspace with eight reduced versions: minimal leaky state, recurrence, sensory observer, journal output, semantic return, journal memory, bounded WRITE_JOURNAL/WAIT choice and regulation. Paired fixed-reply comparisons retain identical text and codec vectors; independent generation is a separate mode. Exact records distinguish prepared prompts, completed replies, saved journals, context exposure and next-step applied input. New journals and runs remain in the research project. The observation is the separate input-driven sensory field; it is not the reservoir state. No live-being changes or writing-quality result is claimed.
card.source: Mike's September 10 acceptance of the action/comparison ladder

log.title: Make journal output and its return separately inspectable
log.body: Implemented research-local journal actions, matched comparisons, synchronized state views and portable replay. Fixed synthetic checks show that output-only leaves reservoir state unchanged, while semantic return first changes state on step31 after writing at30. Fixed memory exposure alone leaves writing and state unchanged by construction; it is not a writing-quality experiment. Final validation and presentation limits are in the build receipt. Artifact connector unavailable; authenticated board editing unavailable; publication pending.
